description: Small language model built in Minecraft.

summary.one_liner: CraftGPT is a small language model implemented as redstone circuits inside Minecraft, trained on the TinyChat dataset and run through the MCHPRS redstone server.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a small language model built to run inside Minecraft using redstone mechanics, trained on the TinyChat dataset. The author warns that output is often off topic, ungrammatical, or garbage, and that the context window is only 64 tokens. Running it requires MCHPRS, a high-performance redstone server, with the plot scale set to 7 and compiled from source. The user downloads the provided MCHPRS world, loads it, compiles the redstone circuit with the /rp command, and enters a prompt using a button-and-binary input panel. A default RNG seed of 1 can be changed by entering a binary value. Responses can take hours even with MCHPRS. The README also describes how to reset the model by reloading the world or pressing buttons in the build.
use_cases: Experimenting with a language model built from redstone in Minecraft
Running a tiny chatbot inside a Minecraft world
Studying how neural networks can be implemented with logic circuits
Demonstrating computation in vanilla-style redstone builds
how_to_run: Download MCHPRS, set the plot scale to 7 in ./crates/core/src/plot/mod.rs, and compile it
Download the MCHPRS world, unpack it at ./target/release, and rename it to world
Log on to MCHPRS (version 1.20.4) and type /rp c -io to compile the circuit (about 10 minutes)
Optionally enter a different RNG seed in binary at 230, 150, 1000 and push the confirm button
Type a prompt and press enter, then wait for the response (can take hours)
notable: Entire language model is built from Minecraft redstone circuits
Requires MCHPRS plot scale 7 and MCHPRS world download
Input prompt via in-game buttons and binary counters; RNG seed configurable
caveats: Needs at least 32GB RAM to load the server, ideally 64GB or more
Responses can take hours even with MCHPRS; vanilla tick rate could take years
Output quality is poor: often off topic, ungrammatical, or garbage
